summary: Frontend-only testing of new client-side Email+Password auth on SynapseEDU Learning Hub. Executed 9 Playwright scenarios covering login rendering, valid/invalid login, register toggle, short-password validation, duplicate email, new user registration + fresh learning profile, logout, and quick demo login. All 9 scenarios passed.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth is client-side only in preview (SHA-256 + random salt in localStorage). Adequate for demo but NOT production-safe (passwords hashable offline, no rate limiting, no httpOnly cookies). Node backend at /app/backend-node exists but is not wired up in preview.
auth.js setMode() clears email/password on switching to register but does not clear the 'name' field or the auth-error box's stale text after successful validation flows — minor UX nit.

state.js setUser() resets the entire learning profile whenever email changes, including when logging back into the demo account after using another account — the previously accumulated demo progress is wiped. Consider keying learning state by user id/email instead of a single global key.
config.js DEMO_MODE toggles solely on API_BASE_URL being empty; no explicit env-driven flag. Fine for demo, but risky if API_BASE_URL is ever set to a non-empty invalid value.
seed_data_creation: None (test registered ephemeral email newstudent<ts>@test.com in localStorage only).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All auth flows verified against preview URL. Errors surfaced via data-testid='auth-error'. Register a new email to observe fresh baseline learning profile (overall 59%, AIMD 36%). Logout on dashboard uses data-testid='logout-btn' in the sidebar user card.
